catalog-api.response-cache:
catalog-api response-cache policy (current): approved by Architecture approval CACHE-17 (2026-09-06), version v1. Apply to catalog reader components that need response caching.

SOURCE: Architecture approval CACHE-17 (2026-09-06), version v1
RATIONALE: Share response-cache behavior across catalog readers; cache absent lookups to avoid repeated backend reads.

```json
{
  "project": "catalog-api",
  "cache": {
    "ttl_seconds": 600,
    "max_entries": 3,
    "eviction_policy": "fifo",
    "namespace": "catalog-response",
    "cache_misses": true
  }
}
```
